notes: Four skills: s7-deck, s7-brochure, s7-social-tile and s7-system.
Each skill lists departures from the design system at the end of every build and offers to log them.
Skills read local rules from s7-local.md in your Claude project.
Only MYKD publishes changes to the design system, the template deck and the canvases.
